Forces a specific package manager to be used. By default, Remotion will auto-detect the package manager based on your lockfile.<br />Acceptable values are `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, `bun` and `nub`.

## CLI flag

Use `--package-manager` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                 | Flag                        |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| [`remotion upgrade`](/docs/cli/upgrade) | `--package-manager <value>` |
| [`remotion add`](/docs/cli/add)         | `--package-manager <value>` |
